import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Load SME customer IDs from SQLite
conn = sqlite3.connect('/input/task_169/context/db/customers.db')
sme_customers = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'", conn)
conn.close()

sme_ids = set(sme_customers['CustomerID'])

# Load yearmonth data
df = pd.read_csv('/input/task_169/context/csv/yearmonth.csv')

# Filter for SME customers and year 2013 (Date between 201301 and 201312)
df_filtered = df[df['CustomerID'].isin(sme_ids) & (df['Date'] >= 201301) & (df['Date'] <= 201312)]

# Calculate average monthly consumption
avg_consumption = df_filtered['Consumption'].mean()
print(f"Average monthly consumption for SME customers in 2013: {avg_consumption}")
print(f"Number of records: {len(df_filtered)}")
